feed.title: Circle Internet Group CEO Jeremy Allaire Executes Class A Stock Sales Under 10b5-1 Plan
feed.summary: Jeremy Allaire, CEO of Circle Internet Group (NYSE:CRCL), sold Class A Common Stock on September 8, 2026, under a Rule 10b5-1 trading plan. feed.title: State regulators add in-person hearings in Dominion–NextEra merger
feed.summary: Virginia's State Corporation Commission has added three in-person public comment hearings for the proposed $67 billion merger between NextEra Energy and Dominion Energy due to significant public interest. While one hearing is scheduled for November 5th in Richmond, the dates and locations for the other two are pending. Judge Samuel Towell noted that although in-person comments won't carry more weight than telephonic or written ones, these hearings are deemed appropriate given the case's broad impact across Dominion's service territory.

feed.title: Moody’s expects DigiPlus earnings to fall 20% this year before staging recovery through 2028 on expansion initiatives
feed.summary: Moody’s Ratings anticipates a 20% year-on-year decline in DigiPlus Interactive Corp's 2026 Adjusted EBITDA, followed by a recovery to previous levels by 2028. The ratings agency assigned DigiPlus a B1 corporate family rating with a stable outlook, citing the company's leadership in the Philippines' online gaming market and strong financial profile. This outlook is supported by low leverage, robust cash generation, and a net cash position.

feed.title: TeraWulf Drops 4% on Profit Taking After a 44% YTD Run; Applied Digital Falls 3%, IREN Pulls Back
feed.summary: Shares of TeraWulf, Applied Digital, and IREN experienced drops on Thursday due to profit-taking after significant year-to-date gains, with no new company news or analyst downgrades to explain the decline. This pullback is seen as a group rotation rather than broad tech weakness, especially as the Bitcoin mining ETF WGMI also fell while the broader Nasdaq 100 showed only minor weakness. Analysts remain positive on TeraWulf, with a recent Buy rating and a $19 target, and its substantial 20-year deal with Anthropic remains intact, suggesting the underlying investment thesis for these AI-infrastructure companies is still strong.

feed.title: KLA at Goldman Sachs conference: growth outlook stays strong
feed.summary: KLA Corporation presented a strong growth outlook at the Goldman Sachs Communacopia + Technology Conference 2026, driven by demand from AI, advanced packaging, and new chip factories. The company reported accelerated revenue growth, a backlog exceeding $12 billion, and significant market share gains in advanced packaging. Despite some supply chain cost pressures, KLA remains confident in its ability to meet future demand and continues to invest in capacity and AI-driven operational efficiencies.

feed.title: Building the Future: Why Galaxy is Sponsoring a Solana DAT
feed.summary: Galaxy Digital is sponsoring a Solana Digital Asset Treasury (DAT), underscoring its belief in blockchain as the future foundation of global markets and specifically Solana's capacity for institutional-grade financial activity. This initiative involves a $1.65 billion private placement in Forward Industries Inc. to create the world's largest Solana digital asset treasury, aiming for active alpha generation through staking, lending, and advanced Solana-native strategies. The company highlights Solana's leading performance metrics, developer growth, and its unique position to accelerate institutional adoption with the backing of Galaxy, Jump Crypto, and Multicoin Capital.

feed.title: BurgerFi International declares Chapter 11 bankruptcy
feed.summary: BurgerFi International has filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection after experiencing significant sales and earnings losses. The company, which owns BurgerFi and Anthony’s Coal-Fired Pizza, has been struggling with deepening financial issues, reporting an $18.4 million net loss in the most recent quarter. A sale of the company is anticipated, with TREW Capital Management, which previously acquired Rubio's out of bankruptcy, having already bought BurgerFi's debt.

Ulta Beauty's strategy emphasizes a connected shopping experience through its physical stores and digital ecosystem, robust loyalty programs, and brand variety to navigate a competitive and evolving retail landscape.

feed.title: 3 paper packaging CEOs talk market volatility, pricing

Companies are responding with price increases and cost-cutting measures, while also navigating challenges like fluctuating demand and agricultural sector issues. Despite these hurdles, they are focused on optimizing operations and building platforms for future growth.

While AI helps with tasks like forecasting and inventory management, there's a growing debate about the authenticity of AI-generated marketing content and its potential to alienate local customers. The article highlights both the benefits and potential drawbacks as small businesses in New Mexico integrate AI into their operations.

The article outlines factors supporting NEE's growth, such as increasing electricity demand, renewable energy expansion, data center opportunities, and strategic partnerships, alongside its strong capital return program.

feed.title: AI fears have hit this data stock. Investor Sarat Sethi sees a buying opportunity

feed.title: Tungsten Automation Named a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Intelligent Document Processing
feed.summary: Tungsten Automation has been recognized as a Leader in the 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Intelligent Document Processing (IDP), marking its second consecutive year in this position. The company attributes this achievement to its ability to deliver production-ready AI for document processing at enterprise scale, coupled with agentic orchestration and governance. Tungsten Automation's flagship platform, TotalAgility™, processes over 10 billion documents annually for major organizations across various sectors, highlighting its significant impact and trusted solutions in document automation.

feed.title: Delta flight to Phoenix returns to JFK amid 'possible pressurization issue'
feed.summary: Delta Flight 791, en route from New York-JFK to Phoenix, returned to John F. Kennedy International Airport after a possible cabin pressurization issue. The Boeing 757-200, carrying 155 passengers and 6 crew members, landed safely, and passengers were later transferred to a new aircraft to continue their journey. Both the FAA and Delta confirmed the incident, stating standard procedures were followed.

feed.title: CWT Unit Gets Rate Hike Nod to Recover Infrastructure Investments
feed.summary: California Water Service Group's (CWT) unit, Washington Water, received approval for new water rates, expected to increase annual revenues by $4.1 million to recover costs from infrastructure investments totaling $26.5 million. This approval highlights CWT's ongoing focus on infrastructure spending and regulatory cost recovery, with the company investing significantly in utility plant and forecasting substantial capital expenditures for 2026. Rate hikes are crucial for utilities to fund capital-intensive operations, maintain and upgrade aging systems, and support reliable service and water quality improvements.

feed.title: Chemours, DuPont, Corteva reach $455 PFAS settlement with North Carolina
feed.summary: Chemours, DuPont, and Corteva have agreed to a $455 million settlement with North Carolina to resolve PFAS contamination claims from Chemours' Fayetteville Works facility. The settlement allocates $380 million to 10 counties and municipalities, and establishes a $135 million reserve fund from DuPont and Corteva in case Chemours faces bankruptcy. This agreement, which includes no admission of liability, also aims to mitigate future environmental impacts and ensure clean water supplies for affected residents.

feed.title: A Lowe’s class action seeks tariff refunds for shoppers who allegedly paid higher prices
feed.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against Lowe's Cos. Inc. alleging that the retailer raised prices to cover tariffs imposed by the International Emergency Economic Powers Act, then failed to reimburse shoppers after receiving $80 million in government refunds. The lawsuit claims Lowe's is unjustly enriching itself by keeping these refunds without establishing a process to repay customers who bore the initial costs through higher prices. The suit seeks to represent a nationwide class of shoppers and demands that Lowe's repay the tariff costs or distribute a proportionate share of the refunds.

feed.title: GE HealthCare, Leo Cancer Care to Collaborate on Imaging, Radiation Therapy Workflows
feed.summary: GE HealthCare and Leo Cancer Care are partnering to integrate advanced imaging solutions and Intelligent Radiation Therapy (iRT) software with Leo Cancer Care's future upright radiation therapy. This collaboration aims to create more connected patient and data workflows, addressing challenges like interoperability, fragmented clinical processes, and access to technology in radiation oncology. The goal is to simplify workflows and reduce the time from imaging to treatment through a patient-centered approach.

feed.title: Amgen Drops 10% on a Trial It Didn't Even Run
feed.summary: Amgen's stock (AMGN) fell sharply by 10% after Novartis' cholesterol drug Pelacarsen failed a Phase 3 trial, even though Amgen was not directly involved. Analysts believe the sell-off was overdone as Amgen's own cholesterol candidate, Olpasiran, differs significantly in potency and dosing, and its established PCSK9 drug, Repatha, continues to show strong revenue growth. Despite the market reaction, institutional investors are reportedly focusing on Amgen's strong balance sheet rather than the competitor's trial results.

feed.title: Tractor Supply Co. to expand Triad footprint after buying land from prominent restaurateur
feed.summary: Tractor Supply Co. has purchased five acres of undeveloped land in Winston-Salem for just under a million dollars, expanding its presence in the Triad area. The property was sold by a prominent local restaurant owner. This acquisition will add to Tractor Supply Co.'s existing 20 stores in the Triad.

feed.title: Microsoft comms chief Frank Shaw to exit after nearly three decades shaping the company's message
feed.summary: Frank X. Shaw, Microsoft's chief communications officer, is set to leave the company at the end of the year after nearly three decades of shaping its message. Shaw, 64, does not have another job lined up and plans to take a break before deciding on his next move. He was instrumental in navigating Microsoft through significant periods, including antitrust challenges, CEO transitions, and the company's recent AI push under Satya Nadella.

feed.title: BR Stock Rises 16.1% in 3 Months: Here's What You Should Know
feed.summary: Broadridge Financial Solutions, Inc. (BR) stock has increased by 16.1% over the past three months, outperforming the S&P 500. This growth is attributed to its high recurring revenue visibility, strong client retention, expanding operating margins, and robust cash flow that supports capital returns. The company also anticipates productivity savings from AI, further contributing to its positive outlook.

feed.title: Bronstein, Gewirtz & Grossman LLC Urges Celsius Holdings, Inc. Investors to Act: Class Action Filed Alleging Investor Harm
feed.summary: Bronstein, Gewirtz & Grossman LLC has filed a class action lawsuit against Celsius Holdings, Inc. (CELH) and certain officers, alleging violations of federal securities laws. The lawsuit claims that Celsius made false and misleading statements and/or failed to disclose cardiac risks associated with their "Alani Nu" products and targeted underage consumers. Investors who purchased Celsius securities between February 21, 2023, and June 3, 2024, are encouraged to join the case by November 3, 2026.

feed.title: Franklin Templeton Announces Distributions for Certain Closed-End Funds Pursuant to their Managed Distribution Policy for the Month of September 2026

feed.title: Q&A: ‘Opine with the spine’: Autodesk CMO Dara Treseder on leading through the AI shift

feed.title: Cruising gluten-free: Inside Royal Caribbean’s Celiac Cruise experience
feed.summary: This article details Julia's positive experience on a Royal Caribbean Celiac Cruise after her celiac disease diagnosis made travel challenging. The cruise, partnered with Celiac Cruise, offers dedicated gluten-free dining spaces, trained staff, and special wristbands to ensure a worry-free vacation for guests with celiac disease. The program has been very successful, leading to expansion and even inspiring Oceania Cruises to offer a similar entirely gluten-free voyage.
